name: Mizusawa Sayaka
source:
Misaki’s class mate.
A bright, energetic and responsible person.

She has a high sense of initiative and always naturally help those who are in trouble.

She has a high popularity due to her personality and ability of reaching up to anyone with no sense of discrimination.

She likes to make music together with everyone and will do her best to succeed in the school festival.
